en.t: Look at the fresh green of the pine trees.

units.source_text: 你瞧，那仪仗队有了松树的翠绿作背景，衬托得更加醒目了。

en.t: See, with the green of the pine trees as a backdrop, that honor guard stands out all the more vividly.

units.source_text: 宽广的御所庭园里净是黑松，所以我太喜欢它啦。”

en.t: The broad garden of the Imperial Palace is full of black pines, and that is why I love it so much.
